name: Tavarov Pay
author: tavarov

sections.description:
Accept real USDT and USDC payments in your WooCommerce store.

Tavarov Pay adds a crypto payment option to your checkout. Customers open a payment page, choose a compatible wallet and pay. The payment goes to your own wallet, with a 1% Tavarov Pay fee deducted in the same transaction. Network fees are separate.

You can accept payments on BNB Chain, Ethereum, Base and Solana. NoN Wallet is optional: customers can also use compatible wallets such as MetaMask, Trust Wallet, OKX, Phantom and Solflare, depending on the network.

There is no merchant balance held by Tavarov Pay and no separate payout to request.

How it works

  1. A customer selects USDT or USDC when placing an order.
  2. The plugin creates an invoice through the Tavarov Pay API and opens the payment page.
  3. The customer pays from their wallet.
  4. The plugin checks the invoice with the API before updating the WooCommerce order.

Payment checks can run after a webhook notification, when the customer returns to the store, or through scheduled background checks. You can also check a payment manually from the order screen.

Included

  • Real payments using your live API key.
  • USDT and USDC on BNB Chain, Ethereum and Solana; USDC on Base.
  • A hosted payment page with a QR code and wallet payment options.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility.
  • Order notes and transaction links to the appropriate blockchain explorer.
  • Underpaid or wrong-currency invoices are held for review rather than marked paid.
  • An optional sandbox using test USDT on the BNB test network.

What you need

  • An active WooCommerce store with prices in US dollars (USD).
  • A receiving wallet and a live API key from https://wallet.tavarov.com/dev.
  • For Solana payments, your Solana receiving address in the plugin settings.
  • For webhook notifications, a publicly accessible HTTPS store and the webhook signing secret from your Tavarov Pay dashboard.

The plugin is free to install. Tavarov Pay charges 1% per payment; blockchain network fees are separate.

For BNB Chain, Ethereum and Base, payments use the Tavarov Pay contract. Solana payments use a transaction signed by the customer. Contract source: https://bscscan.com/address/0x1Fc681FA250A17e66B57B7150F2EeD4e71D1Ca35#code

External services

This plugin relies on the Tavarov Pay API (https://wallet.tavarov.com/api/v1), operated by Tavarov, to create payment pages and to check whether they were paid. Without it the payment method does not work.

What is sent, and when:

  • When a customer places an order with this method: order amount, currency (USDT/USDC), the network and, for Solana, your Solana address, an order reference (order ID plus a short hash of your site address), the text “Order #N”, your site title, the invoice lifetime, the language WordPress uses on the checkout page (two letters, e.g. “en”), the “order received” page address, the WooCommerce order ID and your site’s host name. Your API key is sent in the Authorization header. No customer name, email, address or phone number is sent.
  • When checking a payment (webhook, return page, background check, or the “Check payment” order action): the invoice ID and your API key.
  • With every request: a User-Agent header with the plugin version and your site address, so a failing shop can be identified in the API logs.
  • The customer’s browser opens the payment page at https://wallet.tavarov.com/pay, which reads the chosen network through public RPC nodes to show the payment status.

Tavarov Pay terms of use: https://tavarov.com/terms.html
Tavarov Pay privacy policy: https://tavarov.com/privacy.html

Payments themselves happen on the chosen network between the customer’s wallet and your wallet (through the Tavarov Pay contract on BNB Chain, Ethereum and Base); they are public, like every blockchain transaction.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Tavarov Pay. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Open https://wallet.tavarov.com/dev and sign in with your receiving wallet. Signing the login message does not move funds.
  3. Create a live API key starting with tp_live_. Paste it into WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Tavarov Pay.
  4. Choose your payment network and currency. If you choose Solana, enter your Solana receiving address.
  5. In the Tavarov Pay dashboard, add the webhook URL shown in the plugin settings. Copy the whsec_… signing secret back into the plugin settings.
  6. Enable the payment method and save your changes. Your store can now create invoices for real payments.

Optional sandbox: to check the setup without using real funds, use a tp_test_ key instead. It creates invoices in the BNB test network. Switch to a tp_live_ key when you are ready to accept real payments. A test payment does not transfer real USDT.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin only for testing?

No. Use a tp_live_ API key to accept real USDT or USDC payments. A tp_test_ key is an optional sandbox for checking your setup with test USDT on the BNB test network.

Does my customer need NoN Wallet?

No. Customers can use a wallet compatible with the selected network and the payment page. NoN Wallet is one of the supported options.

What does it cost?

The plugin is free to install. Tavarov Pay charges 1% of each payment. Blockchain network fees are separate.

Who holds the money?

Tavarov Pay does not hold a merchant balance. Each payment sends 99% to your receiving wallet and 1% as the service fee in the same transaction. Blockchain network fees are separate.

My store is not in USD.

Tavarov Pay charges in US dollar stablecoins, so the method is offered only when the store currency is USD. Developers can extend the list with the tavarov_pay_supported_currencies filter if their prices are already in dollars.

What if the customer pays less?

The order is put on hold with a note, and it is not marked paid. The same happens if they pay in the other stablecoin.

Refunds?

Refunds are sent from your wallet (the NoN Wallet app has a refund button for payments made through the contract on BNB Chain). WooCommerce refunds through this plugin are not supported yet.

Is there a token I need to buy?

No. Payments are in USDT and USDC only.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • The order note links the payment to the right explorer: Etherscan, BaseScan or Solscan (it always pointed to BscScan before), and Solana transaction ids are now recorded.
  • Deleting the plugin also removes its pending payment re-checks.
  • The External services section now lists the User-Agent header and says the language sent is the checkout page’s.

1.1.0

  • Translations now come from translate.wordpress.org; the bundled language files are removed.
  • Choose the network: BNB Chain, Ethereum, Base or Solana (Solana needs your Solana address). Base always charges in USDC.
  • The plugin checks that the invoice the API returns is on the network it asked for.

1.0.0

  • First release: invoices, signed webhooks, return-page and background checks, Checkout block, HPOS.
